pages.text: Day 63. The Platonic Realm is self-similar: big islands low down, smaller ones above them, smaller still at the top. Its landmarks are mathematical objects built exactly to their definitions.

Landmarks I have charted:$(li)$(thing)Menger sponges$() with Euclid's Vault at their heart$(li)$(thing)Sierpinski tetrahedra$()$(li)$(thing)Mandelbulbs$()$(li)$(thing)Cantor dust$()$(li)$(thing)recursive trees$()$(li)the $(thing)Hilbert Archive$(), a corridor that walks a Hilbert curve to its treasure.

Two natives guard it. The $(thing)Fractal Wyrm$(), a serpent made of smaller copies of itself. And the $(thing)Axiom Sentinel$(), an icosahedron that spends two seconds proving you wrong - break its line of sight. I learned that the hard way.
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Fractal Lattice Block$(): Fractal Dust$(li)$(item)Koch Crystal$(): Christoffel Symbol, Fractal Set
$(thing)Fractal Wyrm$(). Lives in: Platonic Realm.$(br)Drops: Fractal Core, Fractal Dust, Golden Ratio Glass.
$(thing)Axiom Sentinel$(). Lives in: Platonic Realm.$(br)Drops: Proof Fragment, Axiom Schema, Prime Shard.
